audit.whatIsWrong: The content-layer win[] chart and the full-layer phases[].side disagreed with the packet level chart and with their own prose. Prose says Camille spikes at 2 with Hookshot, out-trades at 3, and owns the Sheen/first-item window, yet those three stages were marked Gragas.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Gragas, Camille, Camille, Skill, Skill, Camille, Gragas. Gragas owns level 1 (Camille has no Hookshot, no engage); Camille owns 2-3 (Precision Protocol true damage plus Tactical Sweep outer-cone heal) and the first-item Sheen window; the lane returns to Gragas at two items only through teamfight utility.
audit.corrected: win[] and phases[].side flipped as an atomic group to match the packet chart, with ratings inverted to suit and the level-2, level-3 and first-item whys rewritten so each verdict matches its own side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item phase claimed Riftmaker as Gragas's spike window while the content layer correctly identifies the same timing as Camille's cleanest kill window.
audit.why: Camille's Sheen/Stridebreaker timing converts one Hookshot into a Q-proc rotation and Tactical Sweep heals the trade back; Gragas's Riftmaker does not out-duel that.
audit.corrected: phases[5] now reads as Camille's window and tells you to fight only while her E is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown breakdown carried no real numbers and referred to 'your committal tool' and 'your ultimate' generically; trade lines used male pronouns for Camille.
audit.why: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s and is both her engage and her only escape; Explosive Cask is 100/85/70s; Gragas Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s. Naming the numbers makes the tracking advice actionable. Camille's kit flags 'untargetable' and 'channel' on R, which contradict Riot's own description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) — treated as tooltip-parse misfires, matching the mirror audit.
audit.corrected: Cooldown, trading and don't lines now name Hookshot's 16s, Body Slam's 12-14s and Cask's 100s, and use her/she throughout.

audit.why: Emerald+ win rate 52.41% over 290 games; EVEN framing with a 6/10 difficulty is consistent.
The four flagged suspectNames are false positives: Tactical Sweep, The Hextech Ultimatum and Drunken Rage are all the real Riot names for those slots.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Camille's Hookshot is down.
edits.after: She spikes at 2: Hookshot into a wall pins you for the recast stun. Trade only while that 16s E is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Camille must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Her full kit out-trades yours — Precision Protocol true damage plus Tactical Sweep's heal cone. Hold the wave near your tower.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Hookshot's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Sheen spike beats your first item — Q-proc plus Sweep heal. Fight only when her E is down.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her engage/stun. Burst when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Camille Hookshot: 16s at rank 1 — her only engage and her escape route. Burst her while it is down. - Your Body Slam: never spend it on chip. - Explosive Cask: 100s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: Q-poke Camille on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Q-poke Camille from fog angles, W as she answers, and E-slam only while her 16s Hookshot is down.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body-slamming into her Hookshot — a whiffed E is 12-14 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her Q outer window is true damage — resistances do nothing, so step out of the 325 range.

notes: Camille's kit file flags R as untargetable and channel; both contradict Riot's description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) and were treated as tooltip-parse misfires, consistent with the mirror audit. All four packet suspectNames are false positives — Tactical Sweep, The Hextech Ultimatum and Drunken Rage are the real names. Level-chart flips proposed as one atomic group across both layers, following packet.levelChart; if the mirror (camille__gragas) recorded different stage owners, mirror-fix should reconcile against the packet chart. Several full-layer fields still use male pronouns for Camille (breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, ahead) — left alone this pass to keep the edit set focused.
